title: Kissed Sweet Italian Split Peas Wrap
description: Sweet, aromatic one‑pot Italian split pea dish served wrapped in fragrant pandan leaf, perfect for a shoji‑friendly lunch.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the split peas and stir to coat with oil for 1 minute.
Pour in water and vegetable broth, then stir in dried oregano.
Add the red wine sugar and light soy sauce, bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and let the peas cook for 35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender but not mushy.
Remove the pot from heat and stir in fresh basil leaves and grated Parmesan.
Pack the warm pea mixture into each pandan leaf, folding to create a small wrap.
Place the wraps back in the pot and steam for 5 minutes to lock in moisture.
Remove the wraps, allow them to cool slightly, then slice in half before serving.
Serve with a drizzle of extra olive oil and a sprinkle of fresh basil.
